action.ac_24.title: AC at 24°C all day
action.ac_24.description: Kept the AC at 24°C or higher for the whole day.
action.shift_heavy_load.title: Ran a heavy appliance off-peak
action.shift_heavy_load.description: Ran the washing machine, geyser or EV charger outside {peak} peak hours.
action.geyser_off.title: Geyser off after use
action.geyser_off.description: Switched the geyser off right after use instead of leaving it on.
action.standby_off.title: Switched off at the plug
action.standby_off.description: Turned TV, set-top box and chargers off at the wall overnight.
action.led_switch.title: Replaced a bulb with LED
action.led_switch.description: Swapped an old incandescent or CFL bulb for an LED.
action.public_transport.title: Bus or metro instead of car
action.public_transport.description: Took public transport for a trip you'd usually drive.
action.cycle_walk.title: Walked or cycled
action.cycle_walk.description: Walked or cycled for a short trip instead of using a vehicle.
action.pressure_cooker.title: Cooked with a pressure cooker
action.pressure_cooker.description: Used a pressure cooker or lid to cut gas use.
action.cloth_bag.title: Said no to single-use plastic
action.cloth_bag.description: Carried a cloth bag or bottle instead of single-use plastic.
action.save_water.title: Saved water
action.save_water.description: Fixed a leak, reused RO waste water or took a bucket bath.
action.plant_tree.title: Planted a tree
action.plant_tree.description: Planted and watered a sapling. Upload a photo for full points.
action.solar_survey.title: Booked a rooftop solar survey
action.solar_survey.description: Requested a site survey from a rooftop solar vendor.
reason.no_heavy_load: Your household has no washing machine, geyser or EV
reason.no_private_vehicle: You already commute without a private vehicle
reason.no_commute_distance: Add your commute distance in your profile
reason.already_walks: You already walk or cycle to work
reason.no_lpg: Your household doesn't cook with LPG
nudge.peak_defer.title: Peak grid hours right now
nudge.peak_defer.body: Demand on the grid peaks until {peak_end}:00. Hold off on {loads} until after {peak_end}:00 to cut load when the grid relies most on fossil power.
nudge.pre_cool.title: Peak starts at {peak_start}:00 - pre-cool now
nudge.pre_cool.body: Run the AC now and raise it to 26°C during peak hours. Your home stays comfortable while peak demand drops.
nudge.off_peak_now.title: Peak demand is over
nudge.off_peak_now.body: If the {load} can't wait for tomorrow's solar hours ({solar_start}:00-{solar_end}:00), now is the next best time to run it.
nudge.standby_bedtime.title: Switch off at the plug before bed
nudge.standby_bedtime.body: TVs, set-top boxes and chargers on standby can use 5-10% of a home's electricity. Turn them off at the wall tonight.
nudge.solar_window.title: Solar hours: best time for heavy loads
nudge.solar_window.body_own: Between {solar_start}:00 and {solar_end}:00 your rooftop panels supply the most clean power. Run the {load} now.
nudge.solar_window.body_grid: Between {solar_start}:00 and {solar_end}:00 solar plants feeding the grid supply the most clean power. Run the {load} now.
nudge.ac_setpoint.title: Set your AC to 24°C
nudge.ac_setpoint.body: Every degree higher saves about 6% of AC electricity. 24°C is the BEE-recommended default.
nudge.ac_setpoint.body_temp: It's {temp}°C outside. Every degree higher saves about 6% of AC electricity. 24°C is the BEE-recommended default.
nudge.geyser_timer.title: Switch the geyser off after use
nudge.geyser_timer.body: A geyser left on standby keeps reheating water. Switch it off right after your bath, or set it to 50°C.
nudge.short_commute.title: Your commute is short enough to ditch the car
nudge.short_commute.body: {km} km a day by bus, metro or cycle avoids about {kg} kg CO2 every day.
nudge.above_baseline.title: You're {pct}% above your baseline
nudge.above_baseline.body: This month's usage is higher than when you started. Check the AC set-point and switch appliances off at the plug.
nudge.below_baseline.title: {pct}% below your baseline - great work
nudge.below_baseline.body: Keep it going. Your ward's leaderboard rank depends on it.
push.green.title: Green Hours start now in {district}
push.green.body: The sun is strongest for the next few hours. Run the washing machine, geyser or EV charger now.
push.peak.title: Evening peak in 30 minutes
push.peak.body: The grid peaks {peak}. Finish heavy loads now, or wait until after the peak.
plan.ac_setpoint.title: Set your AC to 24°C
plan.ac_setpoint.why: Each degree higher saves about 6% of an AC's electricity (BEE). Raising {acs} AC from the common 22°C to 24°C saves roughly {kwh} units a month in the months you use it.
plan.geyser_timer.title: Switch the geyser off after use
plan.geyser_timer.why: A storage geyser left on keeps reheating water and loses about 0.8 units a day. A timer, or switching it off after your bath, saves about {kwh} units a month.
plan.standby.title: Switch off at the plug at night
plan.standby.why: A TV, set-top box and chargers on standby use about 0.3 units a night, roughly {kwh} units a month.
plan.led.title: Swap an old bulb for an LED
plan.led.why: Replacing one 60 W bulb with a 9 W LED saves about {kwh} units a month. Every bulb you swap adds the same.
plan.peak_shift.title: Run heavy loads off-peak
plan.peak_shift.why: Running the washing machine, geyser or EV charger outside {peak} doesn't change your bill, but it takes load off the grid when it leans hardest on fossil power. About {co2} kg of CO₂ a month.
plan.commute.title: Take the bus or metro for some trips
plan.commute.why: Your {km} km a day by {mode} emits more than the same trip by bus. Switching those trips cuts about {co2} kg of CO₂ a month. This doesn't change your electricity bill.
plan.solar.title: Put solar on your roof
plan.solar.why: A {kwp} kW system fits your roof and your use. After the ₹{subsidy} PM Surya Ghar subsidy it costs about ₹{net_cost} and pays back in about {payback} years.
plan.slab: About {units} of your units are charged at the ₹{now}/unit slab instead of ₹{below}. Cutting just those {units} units would save about ₹{rs} a month.
push.bill.title: Log this month's electricity bill
push.bill.body: Your bill is usually ready by now. Add the units and Nidhi shows what you saved and what to do next.
notif.proof_approved.title: Your photo was approved
notif.proof_approved.body: "{action}" is now verified and you earned {points} points.
notif.proof_rejected.title: Your photo was not accepted
notif.proof_rejected.body: The reviewer could not verify "{action}". You can log it again with a clearer photo.
notif.announcement.title: New message from your society committee
notif.campaign.title: New campaign in your society
notif.campaign.body: Your committee started "{title}". Doing the action counts towards the target.
action.carpool.title: Shared a car ride
action.carpool.description: Took one more person along, or rode with someone, instead of driving alone.
action.stairs.title: Took the stairs
action.stairs.description: Used the stairs instead of the lift.
action.reusable_bottle.title: Carried a refillable bottle
action.reusable_bottle.description: Refilled your own bottle instead of buying packaged water.
action.no_food_waste.title: No food wasted today
action.no_food_waste.description: Cooked or ordered only what was eaten, and stored the leftovers.
action.millet_meal.title: Cooked a millet meal
action.millet_meal.description: Made bajra, jowar, nagli or another millet part of a meal.
action.segregate_waste.title: Separated wet and dry waste
action.segregate_waste.description: Kept kitchen waste apart from dry waste for collection.
action.compost.title: Composted kitchen waste
action.compost.description: Put vegetable peels and food scraps in a compost bin or pit.
action.ewaste_recycle.title: Gave e-waste to a recycler
action.ewaste_recycle.description: Handed old phones, chargers or batteries to an authorised e-waste collector. A photo earns full points.
action.repair_not_replace.title: Repaired instead of replacing
action.repair_not_replace.description: Got a phone, appliance or gadget repaired instead of buying a new one.
reason.no_car: You don't drive to work or school.
engine.saves: Saves about ₹{rs} and {co2} kg CO₂ for your home each time.
engine.saves_co2: Cuts about {co2} kg CO₂ for your home each time.
engine.points_only: Earns {points} points. Its impact isn't measured, so Nidhi doesn't claim one.
engine.hot: It's {temp}°C in {district} today, so cooling is your biggest load.
engine.green_now: The sun is strongest now ({start}:00-{end}:00): the cleanest time to run heavy loads.
engine.before_peak: The evening peak starts at {peak}:00. Run heavy loads before then, or after {peak_end}:00.
engine.peak_now: It's peak time until {peak_end}:00. Holding heavy loads now helps the grid most.
engine.morning_geyser: Mornings are when the geyser is on.
engine.night_standby: Before bed is the moment to switch off at the plug.
engine.challenge: Today's challenge for all of Gujarat: double points.
engine.new: You haven't tried this one yet.
score.district: You used {mine} units. {n} similar homes in {district} use about {typical}; the most efficient use {efficient}.
score.state: You used {mine} units. {n} similar homes across Gujarat use about {typical}; the most efficient use {efficient}.
score.own: You used {mine} units, against your usual {typical}. Comparisons with similar homes start once 5 of them have joined.
push.event.title: Peak Hour Challenge at {window}: {title}
push.event.body: Run the washing machine, geyser or EV charger before or after it, and log it in Nidhi.
coach.template: This week you logged {actions} green actions on {active_days} days, {verified} of them verified by GEDA. Together they avoided about {co2_kg} kg CO₂ and saved about ₹{rs} on your bill.
coach.empty: No green actions this week yet. Today’s 3 on Home are a quick start.
ask.ac: Keeping your {acs} AC at {ac_target}°C instead of {ac_common}°C saves about ₹{ac_rs} a month. Each degree warmer cuts the AC's power by about {ac_pct}%.
ask.ac_none: Your home has no AC, so fans do the cooling. Keep them clean and switch them off in empty rooms.
ask.geyser: Switching the geyser off right after your bath, or using a timer, saves about ₹{geyser_rs} a month. A storage geyser left on keeps reheating its water.
ask.geyser_none: Your home has no electric geyser, so there's nothing to change here. A bucket bath saves water too.
ask.solar: Your roof could take about {solar_kw} kW, making about {solar_kwh} units a month. Open Solar to see the PM Surya Ghar subsidy, the cost and the payback for your home.
ask.solar_noroof: Add your shadow-free roof area in Solar to see the system size, cost, subsidy and payback for your home.
ask.solar_has: Your home already has rooftop solar. Run heavy loads between {sun_from}:00 and {sun_to}:00 to use your own power.
ask.bill: Your usual bill is about ₹{bill_rs} for {kwh} units, and each unit you save now is worth about ₹{rate}. Open Bill X-ray to see your slabs and what would cut it.
ask.bill_slab: Cutting {slab_units} units would drop you a slab and save about ₹{slab_rs} a month.
ask.peak: The grid's evening peak is {peak_from}:00 to {peak_to}:00. Run the washing machine, geyser or EV charger before or after it; {sun_from}:00 to {sun_to}:00, when the sun is strongest, is the cleanest time.
ask.led: Swapping one old {bulb_w} W bulb for a {led_w} W LED saves about ₹{led_rs} a month, and every bulb you swap adds the same.
ask.standby: A TV, set-top box and chargers on standby use power all night. Switching them off at the plug saves about ₹{standby_rs} a month.
ask.water: Fix leaking taps, take a bucket bath and reuse RO waste water for plants or mopping. Log it under Save water.
ask.travel: Taking the bus or metro, or walking or cycling short trips, cuts more CO₂ than almost anything at home. Log each trip you swap.
ask.travel_green: You already travel without a car, which is the biggest saving there is. Log your walks and rides to keep your streak going.
ask.general: I can help with your bill, AC, geyser, lights, standby power, peak hours, rooftop solar, water and travel. Try one of the questions below.
nudge.usage_rise.title: Your units rose {pct}% on last month
nudge.usage_rise.body: That's {kwh} more units. Check the AC set-point, the geyser timer and anything left on standby; Bill X-ray shows where the units likely go.
